name: accident-black-spot-detection
description: A location-based road safety application that detects accident-prone black spots, sends proximity alerts, supports incident reporting, and provides emergency SOS assistance.

scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.analytics: cd services/analytics && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.analytics:lint: cd services/analytics && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy app
scripts.analytics:verify: npm run analytics:lint && npm run analytics:test
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run analytics:verify && npm run test:rules
